name: servoy-opencode-host
comment: The @opencode/cli version is PINNED to an exact version on purpose. opencode ships breaking API changes in patch releases (e.g. the prompt attachment field was renamed url->uri in 2.0.26), so we never auto-update. To move to a newer opencode: (1) bump this exact version, (2) re-check the webui API calls (opencode-api.service.ts / status.service.ts) against the new server schema, (3) test, then commit. Changing this version makes OpencodeFolderCreatorJob reinstall on next start.
